steps.fact: The left referent billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH denotes the entity billed under the name Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
Contract MSA-OAK-2018 lists counterparty Oakfield Logistics GmbH.
Oakfield rebranded from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH while Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change.
HRB 88421 is registered to Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
Oakfield Logistics GmbH (contract counterparty) and Oakfield Logistik GmbH (billing entity) denote the same legal counterparty because the rebrand preserved legal identifier HRB 88421.

support_claim: The contract counterparty Oakfield Logistics GmbH and the billing entity Oakfield Logistik GmbH are the same legal entity per the packet's rebrand record with unchanged HRB 88421.
